title: refactor(driver-sql): codemod pilot — generated, byte-identity-proved section split of sql-driver.ts (#29520)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_

Fixes #29520

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:codemod `scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs` 生成的 `sql-driver.ts` 拆分。54 个方法体移入 18 个分节模块,127/129 个类外顶层声明移入叶模块 `sql-driver-top-level.ts`。`check-tenant-chokepoint` 扫描全部非测试 `sql-driver-*.ts`。按裁决 6597555122,`sql-driver-compile-refusal-seam.test.ts` 的 `sources` 加入叶模块。生成文件未手改。
- 为什么改:落实 #29520 第三轮(裁决 6597555122 选项 A)。测试读取清单加入叶模块后,`sql-driver.ts` 从 18,330 行降到 12,456 行,低于 13,000 行的门槛。
- 风险与回滚:纯搬移。54/54 方法体、127/127 顶层声明逐字节相同;撤销拆分可逐字节还原 base;三套驱动测试计数与 base 相同;门禁读数 base = head。打包 `.d.ts` 按 6441032442 B 的第二归一化判通过,四项读数全部相等,阳性对照抓到去掉的 `private`。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:① `scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs` 新增的 `CLASS_PATH_READER_NEEDLES`(三条 needle 为何仍约束方法);② 测试 `sources` 新增那一行;③ 下方 `.d.ts` 读数表。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs --verify --base 7a25b39cf9`,预期 `54/54 moved bodies identical`、`127/127 moved top-level declarations identical`、`18330 -> 12456 lines`,退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:无新裁决。超过 3,000 行,按四件套交接,待您批准后在您定的窗口落地;本 PR 保持草稿。

## What changes

- **`scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs`** (round 3): the three seam-test needles move from `PATH_READER_NEEDLES` into a new `CLASS_PATH_READER_NEEDLES` table: `unsupportedFilterError(`, `withheldFilterError(` and `.INVALID_FILTER`.
  - The reader of these needles now reads the leaf, so a top-level declaration carrying one moves to it. That frees the 29 refusal builders and the 6 declarations that close over them.
  - A method carrying one still stays on the class. The test reads no section module, and it pins `SqlDriver.resolveWithheldFilterRefusal` by name.
  - Measured: dropping the three needles outright moves that method too (55 methods, 12,449 lines), and the test's enumeration would then go red.
  - A stale class needle refuses, as a stale needle does.
  - `--self-test`: 43 cases in 5 pinned batteries. Two mutants are each refused with 2 failures:
    - the method rule removed;
    - the class needles applied to top-level declarations.
- **`sql-driver-compile-refusal-seam.test.ts`**: `sources` gains `sql-driver-top-level.ts` under a `[#29520 codemod]` comment, in the same form as hand cuts 13, 15 and 16. The enumeration prose names the leaf too.
  - This migrates a path reader (#25521 ask 3). It is not an edit of generated output.
  - Ablation: without the new line the test fails 3 of 115 at head (the positive control and both enumeration sets). With it, 115/115 pass.
- **Unchanged from round 2:**
  - lever (a): section modules may import values from `sql-driver.ts`. This round it exports no staying helper, because every helper the moved bodies read now sits in the leaf;
  - lever (b): one leaf that never imports back;
  - the stub host's bound `getBuilder`;
  - the widened `check-tenant-chokepoint`;
  - the `no-yield` rule;
  - no re-indentation.
- **The generated split:** `--write` on origin/main `7a25b39cf9`, unedited. Its `sql-driver.ts` is the same blob as round 2's base `2ea604223a`. It produces `sql-driver.ts`, the leaf, and 18 section modules:
  - `lifecycle`, `crud`, `sequence-semantics`, `bulk-operations`, `aggregation`, `distinct`;
  - `window-functions`, `query-plan`, `schema-sync-section`, `rotation`, `managed-drift`, `internal-helpers`;
  - `filter-helpers`, `field-mapping`, `window-function-builder`, `column-creation`, `database-helpers`, `sqlite-serialisation`.

## Measurements

| Reading | Value |
|:--|:--|
| `sql-driver.ts` lines (`wc -l`) | 18,330 → **12,456** (−5,874). Bar: below 13,000. **Met** |
| Methods | 54 of 254 move (2,596 body lines out, 616 stub lines in, 36 import lines) |
| Top-level declarations | 127 of 129 move (3,784 lines with their docblocks). 2 stay, both `path-reader`: `JSON_COLUMN_TYPES` and `MEDIA_ID_VARCHAR_CHARS`, which the cli pins read |
| Leaf / new files | `sql-driver-top-level.ts` 3,999 lines; all 19 new files 9,575 lines |
| Byte-identity | 54/54 bodies, 127/127 top-level declarations identical; undoing the split rebuilds the base byte-for-byte |
| Determinism | output tree sha256 `f5d8722fa697b4530b9f76922c2b5d579f69048463e09cf190693793400b26e0` on three runs: `--write` in the worktree and two plan runs on a fresh extract of main. Input sha256 `9abf7867fd98…` |
| Chokepoint readings | base (main, widened gate): 24 `getBuilder()` bindings, 21 read doors, 3 inserts, 4 tenant predicates, 0 D8 arms across 14 files. Head: identical across 33 files. The per-door lists are byte-identical |
| Export lists | `.d.ts` 92 = 92; runtime CJS 59 = 59 and ESM 59 = 59 (CJS = ESM) |
| Changed lines | 16,903 (+10,373 / −6,530, 23 files) |

### `.d.ts`: ruling 6441032442 item 1, second normalisation, with ruling 6597555122's header clarification

The normaliser is `dtsnorm.mjs`, sha256 `9e3ca459fb22015c7e77e4576b564ca46076cfd0f366dc00dcec521274f8e911`. The devx lane rewrote it from the ruling's text. It is a report reading, ⛔ not in `scripts/` (item 3). It does three things:

- It splits each file into top-level statements with the TypeScript API. Each statement keeps its attached comments byte for byte.
- A leading comment separated by a blank line is a detached file-level comment. It leaves the statement stream and is compared on its own as a multiset, so its text still must not change.
- It sorts the statements and the specifier lists inside `import { }` / `export { }`, and masks chunk hashes. driver-sql emits no chunk.

Base is main's unsplit `src`, built. Head is `d23e3c0d06`, built. Each reading below is the same for `index.d.ts` and `index.d.mts`.

| Reading | Base | Head | Verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Raw sha256 | `0f33bf3f…` | `69d9162d…` | differ; raw diff 19 lines, `wc -l` 8,846 → 8,847 |
| **Normalised bytes** | `468260520fcc1ac2…` | `468260520fcc1ac2…` | **identical** |
| **Declared-surface digest** (100 declarations, 585 lines) | `50e5e5be3c1d…` | `50e5e5be3c1d…` | **equal** |
| **Statement multiset** | 106 | 106 | **equal**: only in base 0, only in head 0. Before the specifier sort it is 2 / 2, the two `@objectstack/spec` imports |
| **Export set** | 92 | 92 | **equal**; import specifier set 17 = 17 |
| Detached comments | 2 | 2 | equal texts. The "SQL Driver for ObjectStack" header now sits before `declare class SqlDriver`, which ruling 6597555122 does not count |

**Positive control (catches a dropped `private`).** I dropped `private` from one moved member's stub, `compileFilters`, rebuilt, ran the normaliser on head against control, then restored and rebuilt. The rebuilt head `.d.ts` is byte-identical to the earlier head. The control is caught on three readings:

- normalised hashes differ: `468260520fcc…` vs `73e89389695f…`;
- surface digests differ: `50e5e5be3c1d…` vs `acf70f0378d0…`. It names `PropertyDeclaration [private] compileFilters` → `MethodDeclaration [] compileFilters`;
- the statement multiset is 1 / 1.

The normaliser exits 1 on both files. Its `--self-test` passes 8 cases, among them a member reordered inside its class and a changed header text, both refused.

**Premises.**

- P2: driver-sql `exports` is `.` only. It names `dist/index.*` and no chunk.
- P3: `git grep 'driver-sql/dist' -- scripts package.json` finds 0 hits.
- (e) Dependents are green against the head dist: the driver-turso and driver-sqlite-wasm typecheck and suites ran after the head build.

`already-moved` 78 · `no-yield` 55 · `non-public-static` 47 · `parameter-shape` 21 · `this-write` 19 · `path-reader` 18 · `no-section` 14 · `static` 11 · `comment-in-parameters` 7 · `field-call` 6 · `inferred-return-type` 6 · `type-parameters` 3 · `name-taken` 3 · `reserved-name` 1. The full table is the script's plan output.

</details>

## Tests

Each run is at head `d23e3c0d06`, under one `os-verify-lock` hold (VERDICT command-exit 0). The base runs used main's unsplit `src`, built and then restored in place; status was clean afterwards.

- Type-check: driver-sql, driver-turso and driver-sqlite-wasm each exit 0.
- `@objectstack/driver-sql test`: exit 0 at both. 249 files (237 passed, 12 skipped); 4067 tests (3851 passed, 216 skipped). Base = head.
- `@objectstack/driver-turso test`: exit 0 at both. 96 files; 2530 tests (2496 passed, 34 skipped). Base = head.
- `@objectstack/driver-sqlite-wasm test`: exit 0 at both. 40 files; 750 tests passed. Base = head.
- The five `packages/cli` pin tests that read `sql-driver.ts` by path exit 0:
  - unit: 4 files, 62 tests;
  - integration (`generate-string-family-width`): 1 file, 30 tests.
- `sql-driver-compile-refusal-seam.test.ts`: 115/115. With the new `sources` line removed, 3 tests fail (the ablation above).
- `node scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, 43 cases.

## Acceptance notes

1. **The bar is met: 12,456 lines.** The only change from round 2's measured variant is the ruling's: the seam test reads the leaf. The output tree hash `f5d8722f…` equals the variant's.
2. **The three needles still bind methods.** That is what keeps the test green (see What changes). Literally deleting them would move `resolveWithheldFilterRefusal` into `sql-driver-filter-helpers.ts`, which the test does not read.
3. **`.d.ts`** passes ruling 6441032442 B's second normalisation on all four readings, with the control caught. Ruling 6348891160's union-order bar alone still reads FAIL on these files. Under 6441032442 item 1, that is the case the second normalisation exists for.
4. **Full `pnpm build`** exits 2 in `@object-ui/app-shell` (`Cannot find module '@object-ui/mobile'`), outside this change. Every driver and cli closure used here builds.
5. **Size.** 16,903 changed lines is over the 3,000 threshold. Per ruling 6597555122 the PR takes the four-piece hand-off and a maintainer approval, and lands in the window the maintainer sets. It stays a draft.
6. **`skip-changeset`:** the `.d.ts` meets item 1 by ruling 6441032442, so per item 4 it takes no changeset.

## Verification

- Byte-identity: `node scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs --verify --base 7a25b39cf9`.
- `.d.ts`: build `@objectstack/driver-sql` at main's unsplit `src` and at head. Then run `node dtsnorm.mjs --diff BASE/index.d.ts HEAD/index.d.ts`, and the same for `.d.mts`. Expect exit 0 and `"pass": true`. The #29520 report gives the normaliser's path and sha256.
- Chokepoint: `node scripts/check-tenant-chokepoint.mjs` prints the readings line.
- Re-running in the landing window: merge the latest `main` and take `main`'s `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src`, keeping this branch's `sql-driver-compile-refusal-seam.test.ts`. Then run `--write` and commit.

<details><summary>Gates at head d23e3c0d06</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 73 families at `d23e3c0d06`. Each was run alone, with its exit captured before any pipe: 73 exit 0.
- The `--ran` reconciliation reads 73 derived, 73 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, exit 0.
  - It warns STALE TREE: main moved 20 commits after this round's merge.
  - Those commits change 5 `scripts/pm` and test-shard files the derivation reads.
  - They change nothing under `packages/drivers`, `packages/cli/src/commands`, or the two scripts this PR changes.
- Ten extra commands each exit 0:
  - the codemod's `--self-test` and `--verify --base`;
  - `check-tenant-chokepoint` `--self-test` and its main run;
  - `check-settings-deny-roster` `--self-test` and its main run;
  - `check:adr-anchors`, `check:adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-nul-bytes`;
  - the seam test alone.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the changed files: exit 0.
- `check:commit-card-trailers` passed on the push.

</details>
